title: Top frame: brand mark, six Latin-over-CJK nav pairs with the current one in cyan, three icons in the rail, the y152 hairline
use: The top band of every screen of a dark dossier-style site or launcher. current picks the cyan item.

current.note: which nav pair is the current screen (cyan)

nav_x.note: x of the first nav pair, 1920 units

icons.note: share, audio (cyan) and account icons in the rail

relations: Nav pairs start at x 772 with 80-unit gaps; Latin 22 over CJK 14, left-aligned.
The rail hairline x 1683 crosses the band; the three icons sit inside the rail at 75-unit pitch.
The y152 hairline closes the band.
decoration: The lens-and-beam brand mark, the icons and the hairlines: drawn.

provenance.corpus: fogwake case (雾航信标 FOGWAKE): our own original game site and two in-game screens in the lattice-dossier grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/lattice-dossier/style.json provenance (official site captured and measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: computed style of the reference nav (Latin 22 / CJK 14, item starts 772, 902, 1100, 1271, 1412, 1548: gaps 79-80) and pixel samples of the hairlines
measured: Reference: hairline y 152 at about 85/255 on black; icons at x 1733, 1808, 1883.
Case: six pairs fit 772-1550 with our labels.
